architecture: React StrictMode boots App; App owns routes, settings, installed maps, local replay history, playback selection and global overlays.
Local archives -> bounded ZIP extraction -> mania parser -> IndexedDB packages/beatmaps/backgrounds -> blob media cache -> Web Audio/gameplay renderer.
GameplayCanvas owns live/replay timing; mania ruleset and render math are shared helpers. WebGL2 draws the playfield; React draws HUD and menus.
Read-only Vercel API endpoints expose config/health and mirror catalog search. Downloads go directly from browser to public mirrors.
LocalStorage persists settings/history; IndexedDB persists media packages; service worker supplies offline caching. No database/auth/upload service remains.
